name: Cover-Recursive Peripheral Partial Cubes Are Not Gated-Amalgam Closed
statement: The cover-recursively peripheral class is not closed under proper gated amalgamation.
proof: Each copy of $\mathcal L_4$ is gated in $\mathcal W_8$: every vertex in the opposite factor has the common root as its unique gate. Both factors belong to the class, while their union is a forbidden pc-minor for it.
